findings.problem: Header start time is described as toLocaleTimeString('ko-KR',{hour12:false}) 'truncated to HH:MM', but that locale call returns HH:MM:SS; the truncation rule is unspecified.
findings.fix: Use new Date(startTs).toLocaleTimeString('ko-KR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hour12:false}) which yields '14:32' directly, instead of slicing an HH:MM:SS string.

findings.problem: D4 requires an absolute time in a title tooltip; current addActivity has no title attribute and the design never pins the tooltip string format.
findings.fix: Specify el.title = new Date(ev.ts).toLocaleString('ko-KR') on the row time element.

findings.problem: A 15s open-block ticker means the in-progress duration can lag reality by up to ~15s and a sub-tick turn may show 0초; acceptable but unstated.
findings.fix: Add one sentence: the open-block duration refreshes on a 15s cadence and is therefore approximate; the exact final duration is written at turn_end. No code change required.
